title: Repair candidate-v9 macOS Metal failures

scope: Repair the mandatory physical macOS Metal failures exposed by F8-28 on exact candidate realtime-single-step-v1-ba67db3. Reproduce the zero-argument rope_realtime_finalize_self_contacts Metal binding failure and the independent desktop/mobile reset semantic mismatch from docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-28-CANDIDATE-V9-MACOS-METAL-FAILURE.json. The canonical /Applications bundle verifies the exact repaired revision/backend and passes all 30 public cases plus the complete 12-scenario, five-negative-control and five-workload capture in plain and validation modes.

Attach exact source/tree, device, toolchain, binary, deployment, manifest, generated Metal/reflection and raw before/after artifact hashes. Preserve the F8-28 candidate-v9 failure as immutable history and do not union its partial passes with repaired-source evidence.

Mechanically compare all F8-70 protected closures. The expected adapter-binding and shared-Gallery changes require F8-74 to freeze a new immutable candidate and reroute every affected physical row before any final qualification is reclaimed.
